Our Story

2018 — The First Hello

It all started in 2018 — a chance encounter at a friend’s gathering that neither of us expected would change everything. We remember that day vividly: shy smiles, shared jokes, and the instant comfort of talking to someone who felt familiar from the start.

2023 — The Proposal

After years of shared moments, one evening by the sea, everything came full circle. The sunset painted the sky, the world felt still, and a simple question changed our story forever. It wasn’t about perfection just a moment filled with gratitude, love, and the promise of forever.

2026 — The Celebration

Now, surrounded by the people who’ve been part of our journey, we’re ready to begin the next chapter. This year marks not just a wedding, but a celebration of everything that brought us here the laughter, the lessons, and the love that continues to grow. We can’t wait to share this special moment with you.
